TOKENIZER-2.DynamicRing.BlockAnimationCo:
Dynamic Ring mode writes the token's subject texture as a static atlas, so animation cannot be preserved. Switching on Dynamic Ring will:

  • Clear every per-layer animation preset.
  • Remove any video-backed layers (webm / mp4 / gif).

TOKENIZER-2.DynamicRing.VideoLayerBlocke: Tokenizer 2: video layers are not supported in dynamic ring mode.

TOKENIZER-2.LassoHint: Draw around the area to remove - release to cut

TOKENIZER-2.NoFrameLayersHint: No frame layers in the stack yet — add one using the Browse Frames/Rings button above.
TOKENIZER-2.FrameRayHint: Clips to the inner window of the selected frame layer.
TOKENIZER-2.FrameMarchingHint: Clips to the outer shape of the selected frame layer.
TOKENIZER-2.NoMaskLayersHint: No mask layers in the stack yet — add one using the Browse Masks button or the Paint Mask tool above.
TOKENIZER-2.AlphaMaskHint: Uses the mask layer's luminance to reveal (white) or hide (black) this layer.
TOKENIZER-2.FRAME_BROWSER.NoCustomFrames: No custom frames yet. Click “Browse Files…” to add one.
TOKENIZER-2.FRAME_BROWSER.NoFavorites: No favorites yet — click the star on any frame.
TOKENIZER-2.LiquifyHint: Drag to warp pixels. Bakes to file on deactivate.
TOKENIZER-2.MaskPaintHint: Left-click to reveal · Right-click or Shift to hide · Shift+Scroll to resize brush · Ctrl+drag to pan
TOKENIZER-2.WildcardTooltip: This actor uses wildcard token images. Saving creates a new numbered variant without changing the wildcard path.
TOKENIZER-2.Settings.WildcardAsteriskHin: When enabled, wildcard detection also requires an asterisk (*) in the token path. Enable this if you use art packs that set Randomize Wildcard Images without using glob patterns.
TOKENIZER-2.Settings.DisableAvatarClickH: When enabled, clicking the portrait opens the default file picker instead of Tokenizer 2. Shift+click always opens the opposite application. Individual users can override this with their own preference below.
TOKENIZER-2.Settings.DisableAvatarClickU: Override the world default for your own account. Shift+click always opens the opposite application.
TOKENIZER-2.Settings.TourShownHint: Uncheck this to see the guided tour again the next time you open the editor.
TOKENIZER-2.Settings.MenuHint: Set default rings, save locations, and background image.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.ApplyDefaultRin: Automatically add the matching disposition ring as a mask layer when opening a new token in the editor.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.FitPortraitToRi: When auto-applying the default ring, scale the portrait so its largest side fits within the ring's inner boundary.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.RingsHint: Default ring images applied per token disposition when a new token is opened in the editor.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.LocationsHint: Default server folders where exported token images are saved.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.TokenNameHint: Filename templates for saved tokens. Use {{name}} for actor name, {{id}} for actor ID, {{tokenId}} for placed token ID, or {{system.path}} for any actor field.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.TokenNameLinked: Used for sidebar actors and linked canvas tokens.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.TokenNameUnlink: Used for unlinked canvas tokens. Include {{tokenId}} to ensure unique filenames per token.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AvatarLocations: Default server folders where exported avatar/portrait images are saved.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AvatarNameHint: Filename templates for saved avatars. Use {{name}} for actor name, {{id}} for actor ID, {{tokenId}} for placed token ID.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.ApplyDefaultBac: Automatically add the default background image as the bottom layer when opening a new token in the editor.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.BackgroundHint: Default background texture or image placed beneath all layers when a new editor session opens.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AdvancedHint: Advanced settings for troubleshooting and integration.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.ExportSizeHint: Resolution of the exported token image. Larger sizes produce sharper tokens but use more storage.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.ExportFormatHin: File format for saved token images. WebP produces smaller files; use PNG for maximum compatibility.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.ProxyUrlHint: Prepended to external http(s) image URLs to avoid CORS errors. Leave empty to disable. The source URL is appended directly after this value.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.DisableLayerPer: When enabled, intermediate tool results are kept in memory instead of being uploaded to the server, and the layer stack is not saved to actor data. The editor always starts fresh when reopened. Reduces disk usage in cache and paste folders.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.UseDynamicRingD: Use Foundry Dynamic Ring by default
When enabled, new editor sessions use Foundry's native dynamic ring system instead of baking the ring into the token image. The ring appears as a non-exportable preview layer during editing.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.DefaultOversize: Enable the oversized ring automatically on first open so the token spills into surrounding spaces.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.LicensesHint: Tokenizer 2 uses the following open-source libraries. Thank you to their authors!
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.LicenseMagicWan: Flood-fill and contour-tracing library used by the Magic Lasso tool.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.LicenseMediabun: JavaScript media toolkit (reading/writing/converting) used by animated token export.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AnimationHint: Defaults used when a layer stack contains animated content. Animated tokens save as .webm; static tokens continue to save as PNG/WebP.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AnimationFpsHin: Higher FPS is smoother but produces larger files and slower exports.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AnimationMaxDur: Hard cap on the length of a single animated token loop.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AnimationBitrat: Target encoder bitrate. 1-2 Mbps is ample for 512px tokens.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AnimationExport: Animated tokens default to 512 px - 4K animated is unnecessarily large.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AnimationCodecH: VP9 gives smaller files; VP8 is a fallback for older browsers.
TOKENIZER-2.SETTINGS_APP.AnimationEncode: Pick a registered animated-output encoder. Plugins may add extra formats.

TOKENIZER-2.Tour.Title: Getting Started with Tokenizer 2
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.Description: A quick guided tour of the token image editor.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.EditorMustBeOpen: Open the Tokenizer 2 editor first, then start the tour.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.WelcomeContent: This is your canvas - where you compose a token from multiple layers. The editor has three columns: adjustments on the left, the canvas in the centre, and layers on the right.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.ZoomContent: Use these buttons to zoom in, out, or reset the view. You can also scroll the mouse wheel to zoom, and drag with the middle mouse button or hold Space to pan.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.UndoRedoContent: Made a mistake? Undo and redo your changes here. Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.AnimationContent: Give any layer an animation preset (rotate, breathe, pulse, shimmer) from its Adjustments panel, or drop in a .webm / .mp4. When anything is animated a play button appears here for live preview, and saving writes a looping .webm.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.SaveContent: When you're done, click Save to write the token image back to the actor. You can also Download a copy, use Quick Token presets, or open Settings.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.ModeToggleContent: Switch between Token and Avatar editing modes. Token mode produces a circular token image with frames and rings. Avatar mode lets you edit the actor's portrait at any aspect ratio. Each mode keeps its own layer stack.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.LayerPanelContent: The right panel is where you manage your layer stack, frames, and masks. Layers are composited from bottom to top - just like image editors you may already know.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.LayerListContent: Click a layer to select it. Drag layers to reorder them. Each layer has visibility and lock toggles on the right. Double-click a layer name to rename it. Right click on a layer for more options.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.AddLayersContent: Click the + button to add new layers: images from your files, the actor's avatar or existing token, text overlays, mask images, or a painted mask you draw by hand.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.FrameRingContent: Browse the built-in frame library or add a shape ring to give your token a border. Frames automatically mask the layers below them.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.MasksTabContent: The Masks tab gives you a global view of every mask across all layers. You can add, remove, and configure masks for any layer without having to select it first. Masks control which parts of a layer are visible - use alpha, ring, or frame-based masks to shape your token.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.ToolsContent: The toolbar offers several editing tools: Palette (move/adjust), Transform, Magic Lasso, Freehand Lasso, Liquify, Erase/Restore, Clone/Heal, and Layer Effects. Click a tool to activate it.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.LeftPanelContent: The left panel shows contextual controls for the active tool and selected layer - brightness, contrast, opacity, tint, blend mode, and more. It updates automatically as you switch tools.
TOKENIZER-2.Tour.MinimapContent: The minimap shows your full token composition. Drag the viewport rectangle to quickly pan around when zoomed in. That's the end of the tour - happy tokenizing!
